role: Reproducible static audit evidence for the SEC009 L5/L8 V-pair, unique U-ID mapping, source-derived negative class projection, positive expectation gaps, and incomplete 4-way checker outcome.
obligations: Preserve every existing SEC009 source case ID in L8 case_id and integration_case_ref while assigning a unique U-ID in each unit_cases.id.
Resolve all 285 L8 U-IDs through the L8 shared source index to exactly 285 current L9 integration source IDs and pointers.
Independently compare all 32 L4/L5/L8/L9 class identities and shared values; retain stable L5 rule IDs and validate the L5 owner function against its contract declarations.
For each negative U-ID, compare condition, expected, and expected_preserved to its L4 classification; do not derive these fields from L9 expected_proposal.

Keep eight positive expectations unclosed unless case-specific L3/L10/L4 source facts support an independent expected result; keep row oracle_id and test_citation null where no row source is provided.
Record contract-level L10 oracle refs separately from individual U-ID oracle IDs and preserve the current static check-child report, including its failures.
Keep this evidence scaffold-only; do not treat static results as runtime, security behavior, approval, or formal 4-way completion.
